'''June 2001 Hastings tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at MVP Cards & Collectibles, Hastings, MN on 16 June 2001. [[Jim Li]] won it. It is known from Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2477">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-18-jeeps-report-for-hastings-mn-6-16-01d2477/ jeeps-report-for-hastings-mn-6-16-01], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 18 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-18-jeeps-report-for-hastings-mn-6-16-01d2477/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 June 2001
* '''Site:''' MVP Cards & Collectibles, Hastings, MN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]
